description:
Cast Celestial Gatekeeper by paying {3}{W}{W}.
Celestial Gatekeeper enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Celestial Gatekeeper with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Celestial Gatekeeper, adding {1}.
Celestial Gatekeeper dies, triggering itself.
In response, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Celestial Gatekeeper token, adding {1}.
The Celestial Gateekeeper token dies, triggering itself, exiling itself and returning Celestial Gatekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Celestial Gatekeeper enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Celestial Gatekeeper with haste.
Resolve the nontoken Celestial Gateekeeper's trigger, failing to exile itself and returning up to two more Birds and/or Clerics from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If you returned a creature of the type chosen with Motlen Echoes, it triggers, creating a token copy of that creature with haste.
Repeat from step 3.
